decisions.EV-CURATION-CALF-01: Regional descriptor for four existing calf candidates only; existing E0 lacks this specific longitudinal knee-position claim.
decisions.EV-CURATION-LATERAL-01: Regional scope limitation and refusal of cable-profile ranking; existing EV-60/65/71 alone do not document this specific trial.

promotion_gate: A separately reviewed shared E0 update must reconcile sources_digest and historical policy pins. These IDs are reserved patch proposals, not admitted role authority. No duplication of EV-71 for basic anatomy or EV-68 for variation.
